'''July 2000 Glenside tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in RPG Outpost, Glenside, Pennsylvania on 23 July 2000. [[Livio D'Alessio]] won it. It is known from Ted Panczyszyn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1027">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-23-rpg-outpost-glenside-pa-7-23-2000d1027/ rpg-outpost-glenside-pa-7-23-2000], DeckTech (Ted "Rogue15" Panczyszyn, 23 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-23-rpg-outpost-glenside-pa-7-23-2000d1027/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 23 July 2000
* '''Site:''' RPG Outpost, Glenside, Pennsylvania
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 17
* '''Winner:''' [[Livio D'Alessio]]
